key_parts.question: In the Kaggle Bank Customer Churn dataset (10,000 customers in France, Germany and Spain), what is the churn rate of customers in Germany compared with France and Spain?

answer.question: In the Kaggle Bank Customer Churn dataset (10,000 customers in France, Germany and Spain), what is the churn rate of customers in Germany compared with France and Spain?
answer.answer: In the Kaggle Bank Customer Churn dataset, Germany has the highest churn rate at 32.4% [kaggle_summary_geography, kaggle_segment_geography_germany]. In comparison, France has the lowest churn rate at 16.2%, and Spain has a churn rate of 16.7% [kaggle_summary_geography, kaggle_segment_geography_spain].

chunks.text:
# Churn rate by Geography

Source: Kaggle "Bank Customer Churn" dataset (customers of a bank in France, Germany and Spain). Overall churn rate: 20.4%.

| Segment | Customers | Churned | Churn rate | Mean balance | Mean points |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| France | 5,014 | 811 | 16.2% | 62,092.64 | 607.2 |
| Germany | 2,509 | 814 | 32.4% | 119,730.12 | 610.2 |
| Spain | 2,477 | 413 | 16.7% | 61,818.15 | 601.4 |

In plain language: by geography, the highest churn rate is 32.4% (Germany) and the lowest is 16.2% (France).

chunks.text:
# Churn segment card: Geography = Spain

Source: Kaggle "Bank Customer Churn" dataset (customers of a bank in France, Germany and Spain). Segmentation: Geography. Segment: Geography = Spain.

- Customers in segment: 2,477 (24.8% of 10,000 customers)
- Churned customers (Exited = 1): 413
- Churn rate: 16.7% (overall churn rate: 20.4%)
- Mean balance: 61,818.15
- Mean estimated salary: 99,440.57
- Mean credit score: 651.3
- Mean age: 38.9
- Mean loyalty points earned: 601.4

In plain language: customers with Geography = Spain left the bank at a rate of 16.7%, which is 0.82 times the overall churn rate (lower).
